scripts.gen-types: export $(pnpm --silent gen-env) && supabase gen types typescript --local > src/types.ts
scripts.gen-migration: { pnpm --silent diff-schema-migrations; pnpm --silent gen-view-sec; } | supabase migration new
scripts.gen-view-sec: grep -rhi 'CREATE\( OR REPLACE\)\? \+VIEW ' ./schema/ | sed 's/OR REPLACE //' | sed 's/CREATE VIEW \(.*\) WITH (\(.*\))/ALTER VIEW \1 SET (\2);/'
scripts.diff-db-schema: DIFF_SOURCE=database DIFF_TARGET=schema pnpm --silent tusker:diff && pnpm --silent tusker:clean
scripts.diff-schema-migrations: pnpm --silent tusker:copy && DIFF_SOURCE=schema DIFF_TARGET=migrations pnpm --silent tusker:diff && pnpm --silent tusker:clean
scripts.diff-remote: supabase db diff --linked | supabase migration new init
scripts.tusker:copy: for file in schema/30-supabase/*.sql; do cp "$file" "supabase/migrations/0000-$(basename "$file")"; done
scripts.lint:view_security: grep -ri '\(CREATE\( OR REPLACE\)\?\|REPLACE\) VIEW ' schema/ | ( ! grep --invert-match security_invoker )
scripts.test: export $(pnpm --silent gen-env) && pnpm run test:setup && pnpm run test:lint && pnpm run test:run
scripts.pre-commit:types: export $(pnpm --silent gen-env) && supabase gen types typescript --local | diff src/types.ts -
